SetUpARepo
A person starts a repository with farrier. They write the starter agents.yml, list the demo skill and the
    scaffold in it as the Next line asks, render the install, and seed a folder from the scaffold twice into two
    places. Running the scaffold again keeps what it wrote.

ReplaceAConfig
A person has an agents.yml they wrote by hand. init refuses to replace it. With --force it writes the starter
    in its place. They list the demo skill again and install, then force a fresh starter, which drops the
    selection, and install once more: the skill the config no longer selects is removed.

WrongTurns
A person runs farrier out of order. install with no agents.yml is told to run init. A scaffold on a repo with
    no agents.yml is offered everything the library defines. After init, a scaffold the config does not list is not
    enabled, an unknown one is refused with the ids the library defines, and a library that does not exist is
    refused before anything else is read.
- **bare**: the repository holds no agents.yml. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **hand-configured**: a person wrote agents.yml by hand. Reached by: HandWriteConfig.
- **initialized**: init wrote the starter agents.yml. Reached by: farrier init --repo ..
- **installed**: the starter lists the demo skill and the scaffold, and install has run. Reached by: farrier init --repo .; ListWhatIsWanted; farrier install --repo . --library lib.
story: track50
elements: Install, Scaffold
The book always sends --library and never plays it left out. Without it farrier falls back to the library of the
machine it runs on: $FARRIER_LIBRARY_DIR, the home config, then the base library it finds or fetches
(farrier/farrier/layers.py:95-118). The sandbox cuts the first two and sets STABLEMATE_FETCH_BASE=0, but a base
library installed beside farrier would still answer, so the result would depend on the machine and not on the
claim. The library argument is therefore optional in the declaration, which keeps the runtime from deriving a
missing class for it.
story: track50
elements: Init
init ends by printing a proposed [user_library.claude] table whenever the shared config holds none and stdin is
not a terminal (farrier/farrier/cli.py:179-197). The sandbox config holds only config_version and the command
runs with stdin closed, so every run prints the proposal naming <sandbox>/config.toml. The case where a table
exists is not played, because no command of the book writes the shared config.
story: track50
elements: Install
The number install prints is four launcher files, one skill file for each selected skill, and the root Makefile
only when the repository has none. The renderer adds the Makefile to its outputs when the path does not exist
(farrier/farrier/renderer.py:769-771) and the count is the size of that map (farrier/farrier/cli.py:289). A
second install of the same repository therefore prints one fewer than the first. Where the repository already has
a Makefile, install appends the include block to it and prints a line about that (farrier/farrier/outputs.py:707).
story: track50
elements: Scaffold, enabled, not_enabled
A repository with no agents.yml may apply any scaffold the library defines, and one with an agents.yml may apply
only the scaffolds it lists (farrier/farrier/scaffolds.py:160-167). The model reads that off the watched
agents.yml: no file, or a file that holds "- service-gitignore". The same test decides whether the listing prints
the scaffold or the "No scaffolds available" sentence (farrier/farrier/cli.py:582-583). Aimed at a directory that
does not exist, scaffold finds no agents.yml there and creates the directory with the files in it, so the
elsewhere class of the repo argument succeeds.
story: track50
elements: Install, Scaffold, no_library_to_install, no_library_to_scaffold
A directory is a usable library when it holds a library/ folder, and nothing else is required of it.
`is_library_dir` (farrier/farrier/_vendor/stablemate_core/layout.py:8-10)
tests only `(path / "library").is_dir()`. resolve_library_dir (farrier/farrier/layers.py:122-127) resolves the
path against the working directory and refuses a directory without library/ with the sentence the rules quote.
The book's seed library holds library/ and scaffolds/ and no packs/, so every run proves the tool does not
need packs/.
story: track50
elements: Init, Install, Scaffold, FileRecord
Programs print absolute paths, and a sandbox is a new directory for every world. The surface writes the sandbox
path as <sandbox> in everything the program printed, so a message built from a path is the same text in every
world and the rules quote it. The directory is named acme because farrier prefixes the skills it installs with the
kebab-cased name of the repository's directory (farrier/farrier/naming.py, repo_prefix), so the skill lands at
.claude/skills/acme-demo.
story: track50
elements: Install
install prints "Updated .agents .gitignore rules" when it changes the ignore file (farrier/farrier/outputs.py:696-697),
Wired `make farrier-run-hook` into ... when it wires the hook (the hook manager lines at outputs.py:703-705) and
Added agent launcher include to root Makefile when it appends to an existing Makefile (outputs.py:706-707).
Each is printed once and not again, so the line depends on whether the repository already held the result of an
earlier run. The model keeps the files, not those histories, so the answer leaves the three lines out of the
comparison. The files they describe are still watched.
